articles.title: Bruins Lose 4-1 to the Senators, ‘Make Sure That Never Happens Again’
Senators shaking off doubters with strong start to season
Utah Visits New Jersey to Start Week

away.summary: Utah Mammoth (3-1-0) are on a three-game road trip, having bounced back from a loss to the Rangers with a 5-3 win over the Devils. They are led by Nick Schmaltz (5 goals, 7 points) and Clayton Keller (1 goal, 6 assists), with a strong power play (61.5%) and solid goaltending from Vejmelka (2-1-0, 2.02 GAA, .913 SV%).

home.summary: Boston Bruins (2-2-0) are looking to bounce back from two consecutive 4-1 losses (to Minnesota and Ottawa) after starting the season 2-0. They are led by JJ Peterka and James Hagens (two goals each), with Jeremy Swayman as the primary goaltender (2-1-0, 2.30 GAA, .914 SV%). The team is working to regain consistency and defensive structure.
